name: AI-driven B2B Lead Generation Agent
description: An open-source, self-hosted AI agent that automates B2B lead generation by analyzing user-described products, identifying fitting prospects, explaining the rationale behind each match, and emailing leads directly from the user's mailbox via a command-line interface.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A natural language description of the user's product or service to identify target leads.

inputs.name: email_credentials
inputs.description: User's email account details (e.g., SMTP configuration) used to send emails from their mailbox.

inputs.name: target_criteria
inputs.description: Optional filters or parameters defining characteristics of desired leads.

inputs.name: command_line_arguments
inputs.description: CLI inputs to initiate and control lead generation, explanation, and emailing processes.

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: List of identified leads matching the product criteria, including contact info.

outputs.name: match_explanations
outputs.description: Explanations describing why each lead fits the product criteria.

outputs.name: sent_emails_log
outputs.description: Records and statuses of emails sent to the generated leads.

patterns: AI-based lead profiling from product descriptions
Automated personalized email generation and sending
Self-hosted CLI deployment for privacy and control
Lead explanation for transparent lead qualification
steps: User describes their product or service via the CLI.
The AI agent analyzes the description to infer ideal lead characteristics.
The system searches and identifies leads that match these inferred criteria.
For each lead, the agent generates an explanation outlining why the lead fits.
Personalized outreach emails are composed for each lead.
Emails are sent directly from the user's mailbox using provided credentials.
Logs of sent emails and lead matches are maintained for review.
use_cases: Automating discovery and outreach to potential B2B customers.
Generating transparent lead lists with rationale for marketing teams.
Integrating personalized cold email campaigns into sales workflows.
Self-hosting lead generation tools to ensure data privacy and control.

prompt_templates.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Describe your product or service to generate a list of ideal B2B leads: {product_description}

prompt_templates.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Explain why this individual is a good lead for the product described: {lead_profile}

prompt_templates.name: email_composition_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Compose a personalized outreach email for this lead based on the product: {lead_profile}, {product_description}
